title: Physical monochrome map: open, mark, zoom, focus and close
status: prepared; capture and visual review pending
historical_scope: Current-build input review on the actual selected Act One winter terrain, not a historical event reconstruction. Initial tank position, loader station and held enemy fire are disclosed fixture choices. This is the playtest constructor, not the completed expedition mission loop.
input_audit: Reuse mechanic-review: ordinary Game player camera; set_map_held open/close; native wheel/+/- zoom_held_map; shared zoom-scaled pencil cursor and focus; ordinary pin action. The actual renderer prints current world cartography onto the physical folded sheet. No replacement map, camera FOV override, map-sheet award, scripted vehicle movement or annotation overlay is added.
visual_acceptance: Paper is physically lit and occluded, with current monochrome road and actual building-outline print.
Inspect player marker and map detail; their correctness is not established merely by the input checks.
Pencil and pin remain registered while physical paper zooms and focus moves.
The ordinary loader view returns when the map closes.
limitations: Four-second, 24 fps normal-speed scripted input recording; existing harness advances ordinary simulation/audio at 120 Hz.
Short open/mark/zoom/focus/close demonstration, not route finding, world traversal or a human usability test.
Playtest map availability and initial tank position are staged; this does not demonstrate campaign survey discovery or moving-marker accuracy.
Original gameplay sound is recorded. State checks must not be reported as visual acceptance.
